counterexample: A broken image could list the right better-sqlite3 package version while its native binding cannot load, or COPY stale notes while a server still starts. The native SQLite write/read and exact seven-file hash comparison distinguish both. A conforming alternative can serve a prebuilt frontend with no local node_modules and resolve the two server dependencies from NODE_PATH; the offline unprivileged probe demonstrates that supported path. Vite/TypeScript are build tools, not required server runtime dependencies.
